1f5cb6293a1293df2959ad7e0079b8022e235182.body:
At the conductor's word: patches as files, nothing of the conductor's
edited. generators-timed.patch prints each generator's milliseconds in
the build's log. signed-release-record.patch wires
tools/ci-release-record.mjs into release.sh and validate.mjs: each push
signed with the pushing agent's own key over a digest of the tree; a
forged record is a red gate, an unsigned tree a warning. Tested with the
patch applied and not committed.

Generators in-process: measured and not recommended. Worker threads save
nothing; plain import is 1.4 s faster only because the linker silently
stops linking (a module is not run twice). ci/patches/README.md has the
figures: the linker is 806 ms of a 3.1 s gat
